comment: Upstream releases and the pins they build from, reviewed for compromise before CI builds them (the organization's rule for open-source code). check/reviewed.py enforces it: the Port and Package workflows default to the newest release here and stop on a commit or pin that isn't listed. To add a release: review its changes since the last one and any pin it moves, then add its commit (tag) and pins (check/reviewed.py pins CHECKOUT prints them).

releases.scope: Light Touch in full, qemu-ios d563917e01, usbmuxd 5cb9089, the native archives, the Swift packages and swift-syntax's prebuilt: all clean
